The seed is not identified with the target point without the component argument.

Historical compound targets combine II/IV seed construction and II/III promodular realization. The scripts preserve their remaining IV and III scopes and do not retire a whole target solely because a proper case-II subchain is closed. The merger accepts only exact-source-matched whole-target retirements and preserves original snapshots; the semantic audit itself is reviewed separately by root.

Other actual counts, the compatible common family and gap, genuine theta/toric/local installation, denominator/type/rank identities, actual lattices and metrics, LinkMu and global/spectral comparisons remain explicit. The full original HidaUAlt, ModUAlt, HypothesesHprime, all-rank CountQAlt and unchanged-level LevelPNAlt packages are not inferred from the selected consequences.

The metadata generator deep-copies the archived predecessor checkpoint and map, appends historical results and current scope, and updates the current unversioned map note. Historical versioned records remain preserved. Every current deliverable and version field points to v0.29; the old PDF remains explicitly historical.

The assembler reads only the archived v0.28 cumulative TeX and frozen new components. It writes only the v0.29 cumulative TeX. Every original proof environment is preserved byte-for-byte in order; current summaries and frontier blocks are updated while the versioned historical scope bridges remain.

The merger deep-copies old claims, source records and dependency adjacency, verifies no old field/edge changes, and checks new references and acyclicity. Its updates are additive, source-range-aware and distinguish continuation targets from the original independent global-branch objects.

The final metadata and packaging code require matching source-audit inputs and final draft-TeX hashes before reporting integrity. The ZIP includes all eligible source/report files and its checksum manifest, verifies entry membership, tests ZIP integrity and rehashes every archived file. No source checkout or newly generated proof PDF is asserted.

Review hashes are acyclic: this review binds stable scripts, configuration, component proofs/metadata and archived predecessor records only. It does not bind live source-audit, semantic-audit, mathematical-coverage, final-report, checkpoint, package-validation or its own evidence-output files. The final audit may therefore bind this review safely.
